title: perf(agent-db): retain selected session execution through turn phases

commit.messageHeadline: perf(agent-db): retain selected session execution across turn phases
perf(sessions): reuse empty pending-history counts
refactor(agent-db): keep cohort scope within its reader module
refactor(agent-db): make lazy cohort imports explicit
refactor(agent-db): preserve session callback receivers
fix(agent-db): integrate main and isolate freshness fixture
chore(agent-db): integrate generation admission prerequisite
fix(agent-db): reconcile current reply preparation
fix(agent-db): integrate phase-local maintenance planning
test(agent-db): route mixed model directives through the host worker
fix(agent-db): reconcile generation publication with retained reads
test: repair session fixture cleanup and payload assertions
chore: integrate main fixes into turn-budget step 1
chore: integrate database admission and request lifetime fixes
chore: integrate landed session title CI repairs
fix(agent-db): integrate restart-safe chat target custody
chore: integrate main native slash fixture cleanup
test(sessions): remove unused cohort writer import
merge: integrate main transcript execution and memory capture
fix(sessions): retain admitted reads across compaction successors
fix(sessions): compose main with retained reader handoffs
chore: integrate main fixes for turn-budget landing
chore: resolve turn-budget integration with gateway refactor
chore: integrate activity fixture and search ownership fixes
chore: align turn-budget proof with current worker pools
chore: integrate reply lifecycle consolidation for landing
chore(sessions): integrate main's asset and cron fixes
fix(agents): preserve retained trajectory authority across main integ…
fix(state): preserve cancellation through observed write admission
fix(reply): compose lifecycle and database admission owners
fix(gateway): preserve incognito checks with retained sharing reads
test(sessions): preserve discovery and cohort fixtures across main

Codex review: blocked before merge. _Reviewed October 8, 2026, 3:58 PM ET / 19:58 UTC (Revision 37)._ # ClawSweeper review ## What this changes The branch retains the selected session database across reply phases, batches related reads, and delays maintenance writer admission until a mutation is needed. ## Review scores | Measure | Result | What it means | |---|---|---| | **Overall readiness** | 🐚 platinum hermit **(4/6)** | Real Gateway measurements and focused lifecycle regressions support a worthwhile, correct performance change; failed or cancelled CI is not credited as passing coverage. | | **Proof confidence** | 🦞 diamond lobster **(5/6)** | Sufficient (live_output): Recorded Linux Gateway runs exercise ordinary chat, retained reads, maintenance, compaction, and shutdown after the change, showing lower first-turn and warmed-turn SQL with equivalent completed work. Historical source pins, archive identities, and integration bridges remain explicit; focused regressions supplement the runtime evidence. No stored-data contract changes were identified. | | **Patch quality** | 🐚 platinum hermit **(4/6)** | No actionable review findings were identified. | ## Product **Kind:** Performance · **Worth it:** Yes **User problem:** Chat turns repeatedly prepare the same session database facts, adding avoidable work before replies. **Reason:** Matched Gateway measurements show a useful reduction in turn work. Existing area ownership and recorded direction support the retained-reader approach without new configuration or public capability. ## Merge readiness ⛔ **Blocked before merge - 2 items remain** This PR provides distinct, measured performance value and resolves the previously reported conflict. No actionable code finding was established; current-head CI is failed/cancelled and remains an enforced landing gate. **Priority:** P2 **Reviewed head:** `a7d88719ad32530e1e0ee68c300448487a238e32` ## Before merge - [ ] **Review config compatibility** - Confirm compatibility and upgrade impact for the changed config or default surface before merge. - [ ] **Add data-model compatibility proof** - Confirm migration or upgrade compatibility proof before merge. ## Findings None. ### Provenance - `Session admission and executor lifetime`: original intent not found (unknown: Metadata history was readable, but the introducing reason was not established; the historical content search encountered unavailable partial-clone objects and HTTP 403.)
Agent review details ### How this fits together The Gateway prepares chat turns using session identity, membership, policy, and transcript facts stored in SQLite. The changed reader carries the selected physical database through preparation and returns fresh facts under the existing execution and authority owners. ```mermaid flowchart TD A[Incoming chat turn] --> B[Session admission] B --> C[Retained physical database] C --> D[Fresh bounded worker read] D --> E{Caller and session still current?} E -->|Yes| F[Synchronous reply preparation] E -->|No| G[Reject stale work] F --> H[Release and join accepted work] ``` ### Technical review Best possible solution: Keep one admitted database owner through foreground phases, preserving fresh reads, live authorization, acknowledged lifecycle transfers, and joined cleanup. Do we have a high-confidence way to reproduce the issue? Not applicable to a bug reproduction: the performance problem is demonstrated by matched first-turn and warmed-turn Gateway measurements; this read-only review did not execute code. Is this the best way to solve the issue? Yes: extending the existing execution and reader owners avoids another database owner while preserving physical selection, freshness, and live authority. AGENTS.md: found and applied where relevant. Codex review notes: model internal, reasoning medium; reviewed against [c8283bcc86c7](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/c8283bcc86c70fe89bd7e778dd0845d7c9857ddc). ### Provenance checked - `Session entry worker reads and foreground cohorts` keeps the original intent (https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/164779: Move per-turn session facts off the Gateway thread while retaining physical-store custody and applicable caller checks.) - `Reply initialization snapshots` keeps the original intent (https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/165295: Prepare initial reply snapshots through the existing session readers.) - `Tool-authority fingerprint preparation` keeps the original intent (https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/165370: Move authority preparation to workers while preserving independent caller policy, retained physical sources, FIFO, and final live checks.) - `Gateway sharing and custody reads` keeps the original intent (https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/165600: Prepare exact rows and membership through session readers, then validate original caller authority immediately before dispatch or commit.) - `Chat pre-admission decisions` keeps the original intent (https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/164682: Move initial chat preparation through workers while preserving distinct preparation, invocation, and accepted-input lifetimes.) - `Automatic maintenance planning` keeps the original intent (https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/148630: Move automatic maintenance database work to workers while preserving active-session protection, retention, recovery, and foreign-write rechecks.) - `Trajectory target preparation` keeps the original intent (https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/165410: Prepare trajectory sink targets through the session reader.) ### Testing Proof path: shipped entry point. ### Security None. ### Evidence What I checked: - **Pinned introduction and conflict resolution:** The introduced delta was inspected against b992cfcd9c31b800f2ca8bfb22b4b892ec8a8149. Raw head records confirm the supplied two parents. The REST comparison with the previous reviewed head preserves main's targetDiscoveryLane fixture, and live PR metadata reports mergeable=true. ([`src/config/sessions/session-logical-entry-read.worker.test.ts:54`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/a7d88719ad32530e1e0ee68c300448487a238e32/src/config/sessions/session-logical-entry-read.worker.test.ts#L54), [a7d88719ad32](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/a7d88719ad32530e1e0ee68c300448487a238e32)) - **Live authority at consumption:** Retained reads check execution generation, caller authority, and the native mutation witness before consuming worker results and again before returning; asynchronous consumers are rejected. ([`src/config/sessions/session-entry-read-ordered.ts:106`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/a7d88719ad32530e1e0ee68c300448487a238e32/src/config/sessions/session-entry-read-ordered.ts#L106), [a7d88719ad32](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/a7d88719ad32530e1e0ee68c300448487a238e32)) - **Acknowledged lifecycle transfer:** Initialization and compaction handoffs use committed predecessor/current identities on the same prepared native generation. The admission owner replaces the reader, revokes the old borrow, and joins accepted work. ([`src/auto-reply/reply/reply-turn-database-admission.ts:73`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/a7d88719ad32530e1e0ee68c300448487a238e32/src/auto-reply/reply/reply-turn-database-admission.ts#L73), [a7d88719ad32](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/a7d88719ad32530e1e0ee68c300448487a238e32)) - **Sharing boundary preserved:** Configured incognito target validation precedes both retained and discovery reads. Retained sharing reads refresh membership and compose routing and invocation checks rather than treating captured identity as permission. ([`src/gateway/session-sharing-policy.ts:164`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/a7d88719ad32530e1e0ee68c300448487a238e32/src/gateway/session-sharing-policy.ts#L164), [a7d88719ad32](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/a7d88719ad32530e1e0ee68c300448487a238e32)) - **Real Gateway performance evidence:** The full PR body records three alternating 7b416/789106 Linux Gateway comparisons: first-turn all-thread SQL 3,539→3,441 and warmed-turn SQL 1,340.9→1,249.6, with equivalent memory completion and zero failed SQL.
